m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: There you are! I was worried you'd gathered my body parts and just run off and sold them on the black market! Kidding. Trust you, of course.
Right then, let's hop to it! I'm itching to hop again. And itch. Give the Chronomancer the body parts so he can enchant them back together!
So, remember the whole, 'I am Ozymandias, King of Kings' bit earlier? Yeah, well, so now you know. I was a pretty big deal back then.
Yeah, it's true. Being the ruler of the entire world, it was a pretty sweet gig, but I'm over it. Been there, done that, as they say.
Running about with you, I've really settled into this sort of Wise-Beyond-His-Hundreds-Of-Years Sidekick kind of role.
And now I've a similar thing going with the Sultana. In fact, I think it could be something special. In an official capacity, of course.
Thing is, I need to be a little more... put together. You know, a helping hand to lend. a real one, right? That kinda thing. So I have a plan.
So get this - when Xerxes defiled my tomb, he had my remains dismembered and placed in four separate crypts. He was creative like that.
My Arms were buried in Caravan, my Legs in Caterwaul Canyons, and my chiseled Torso was interred in a Crypt in the Rubal Wastes.
So I'm tied up here with the Sultana, but if you could, you know, gather my body parts, a Chronomancer might be able to put me back together.
I know you're busy saving the Spiral and all, and I hate to impose, but you kinda owe me one, right? Just saying. All right, yeah, thanks!
How's the body part recovery going? I want to put my best foot forward and lend a hand around here, you know? Really put my back into it. Hehe.
